interface.shortDescription: Marrow MCP tools and skill, advisory only, no hooks
interface.longDescription: Advisory only: Marrow's MCP tools and skill let the agent ask Marrow before consequential actions and record results, but nothing is held or enforced, because this package has no hooks. For enforced approvals in Codex, install the marrow plugin from the getmarrow marketplace instead. Install one of the two Marrow Codex plugins (marrow or marrow-advisory), not both: both name their MCP server marrow.
